text: Astronomy is the study of celestial objects, space, and the universe as a whole. Objects in our solar system follow orbits around the Sun, and some even have moons of their own. For instance, Earth's orbit is an ellipse, and the Moon's orbit is approximately 239, 000 miles long. Meteoroids are small particles that travel through space, often creating streaks of light when they enter Earth's atmosphere, becoming meteors. Some meteors burn up completely, but others can survive the journey and land on our planet, forming craters. These craters on Earth and other planets can provide valuable information about the formation and evolution of our universe.
